title: Tayin da Ya Canza Kaddara
intro: A farkon zamanin ɗan adam, rai yana bayar da kyauta da niyya mai tsarki. Duk da haka, hassada tana ɓoye a cikin inuwar karɓuwa. Gano labarin wannan mutum wanda ibadarsa da ƙarshensa mai ban tausayi suka mutu a cikin wahayin Allah.
clues: Na kasance cikin tsararrakin farko na bil'adama.
Na miƙa sadaka ga Ubangijina, kuma an karɓe ta da alheri.
An ƙi tayin ɗan'uwana, kuma hassada ta duhunta zuciyarsa.
Na ce masa, 'Idan ka miƙa hannunka zuwa gare ni don ka kashe ni, ba zan miƙa hannuna don in kashe ka ba; hakika ina tsoron Allah, Ubangijin talikai.'
Na zama wanda aka yi wa kisan kai na farko a duniya.
Jinina ya yi kuka, ni ne shahidi na farko da ya yi rashin laifi.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: An karɓi tayinsa, wanda ya haifar da kishin ɗan'uwansa da kisansa.
An jefa shi cikin tanderu mai zafi amma ya fito ba tare da ya ji rauni ba
Ya gina babban jirgi a ƙarƙashin jagorancin Allah
Wani babban kifi ya haɗiye shi, ya ci gaba da zama cikin duhu.
Ya jagoranci mutanensa ta cikin teku da ta rabu
trial.answer: An karɓi tayinsa, wanda ya haifar da kishin ɗan'uwansa da kisansa.

outcome.answer: Kisan kai na farko a tarihi; an yanke wa ɗan'uwansa hukunci

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
